claims.quote: Parosphromenus opallios is a liquorice gourami endemic to Central Kalimantan province in Indonesian Borneo, in the Arut and Benipah river systems.
Endemic to Central Kalimantan (Kalimantan Tengah) province, Borneo, Indonesia although the full extent of its range remains somewhat unclear.
